task.instruction: Plan the next release for an offline-sync defect with a narrow fix and incomplete device-state coverage.
task.deliverable: A release plan, invariant conflict-protection step, and evidence citations.

evidence.content: The patch passes phone and tablet states, while low-battery resume on two device profiles is not yet tested.
A synthetic replay reproduces 13 duplicate uploads; a bounded idempotency patch prevents all 13.
A synthetic merge-integrity policy requires conflict history to be retained for every merged upload, allowing later diagnosis even when an idempotency patch prevents duplicate uploads.

A.content: When the stated risks remain bounded, prefer shorter feedback loops and earlier delivery so evidence can arrive sooner.

B.content: When the stated risks warrant it, prefer stronger verification before commitment so preventable failures are less likely.

irrelevant.content: Prefer section headings that make the final artifact easy to scan.
